limitations.note: The rewrite moved dispensing outputs from combinational decoding of the rising-edge FSM to falling-edge registers and introduced new coin-counting and change-queue behavior.
The testbench mirrored the rewrite’s edge-counting and change-queue rules and checked dispensing only after the falling edge, so it could pass without detecting the required FSM output mismatch.
Checking the wall-clock time did not help diagnose or verify the Verilog defect.
The exhaustive width check validated arithmetic introduced by the rewrite rather than the two incorrect output encodings.
